descriptions.permits: Permits each project needs, from the permit engine, with authority and lead time.
descriptions.inspections: Walks run from a template, with results per item and sign-off.
descriptions.inspection-templates: Reusable checklists with ordered, critical-flagged items.
descriptions.incidents: The incident log for every project, from report to signed-off close.
descriptions.dispatch-board: Open incidents and who is responding, live.
descriptions.emergency-codes: The standard emergency codes and their protocols.
descriptions.radio-channels: The radio plan: channels, zones and who listens.

permits.title: Permits
permits.chooseProject: Choose a project in the filter to run the permit engine for it.
permits.noProjects: No projects yet. Create a project with its jurisdiction, then generate its permits here.
permits.empty: Choose a project in the filter, then generate its permit requirements from canon.
permits.noAnswerUnresolved: The project's jurisdiction is not set, so the permit engine cannot say which permits apply. Set the jurisdiction in the project's settings.
permits.noAnswerUnpopulated: Canon declares {jurisdiction} but has no permit rules for it yet, so the engine gives no answer rather than a false all clear. Choose a populated jurisdiction or wait for canon.
permits.engineBody: Reads the canon permit rules of {chain}. {count, plural, =0 {No requirements generated yet.} one {# requirement so far.} other {# requirements so far.}} Running it again adds only rules not yet listed.
permits.generated: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new: every applicable rule is already listed.} one {Added # requirement.} other {Added # requirements.}}
permits.untrackedOnBoard: {count, plural, one {# requirement is} other {# requirements are}} not tracked yet and not on the board. Open one to track it.
permits.untrackedReadOnly: No Permit record tracks this requirement yet. A coordinator on the project opens one.
permits.canonNote: The rule, condition, authority and lead time are canon (Bible tab 15) and cannot be edited here.
permits.trackBody: Opens a Permit record on the project, titled with the canon permit, so its state, permit number and dates can be followed.
permits.noMoves: No state change is allowed from here.

fields.numberHelp: As issued by the authority. Recorded, never generated.

templates.title: Inspection Templates
templates.empty: No inspection templates yet. Add one, then list the items an inspector checks.
templates.emptyReadOnly: No inspection templates yet. A Manager or Admin adds them here.
templates.archivedNotice: This template is archived and cannot start new inspections. Restore it to use it again.
templates.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}} · {critical} critical
templates.noItems: No items yet. Add the first check below.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.noProjects: No projects yet. Inspections are run on a project; create one first.
inspections.noTemplates: Inspections run from a template. Add a template with its items first.
inspections.empty: No inspections yet. Start one from a template on a project.
inspections.frozen: Signed off. The results are frozen; start a new inspection to record new findings.
inspections.punchOpened: A punch item, {key}, was opened to correct this.
inspections.signOffConfirmBody: Signing off freezes every result. The inspector cannot sign off their own inspection.
inspections.answerAllFirst: {left, plural, one {Answer the last item before signing off.} other {Answer the # remaining items before signing off.}}
